about.title: About Me
about.description: Strategy & Ops leader who bridges product, engineering, and commercial teams — turning complex problems into scalable systems and measurable growth.
paragraphs: I enjoy turning complex problems into clear strategies and working with cross-functional teams to launch initiatives that drive growth and improve customer experience.
Outside of work I enjoy hiking, long walks with my dog, reading, traveling, and experimenting in the kitchen.

items.title: Marketplace Growth Strategy & Supply Health Framework
items.description: Industry: Travel & Mobility Marketplaces. Developed analytical frameworks to evaluate marketplace supply health, including activation cohorts, churn dynamics, and lifetime value trends. The work helped identify structural supply gaps and inform host acquisition and expansion strategies. Impact: improved supply visibility across markets and informed initiatives contributing to double-digit marketplace supply growth and stronger unit economics.

items.title: Customer Service Strategy & Operating Model
items.description: Industry: Online Travel Platform. Designed a forward-looking customer support strategy focused on improving operational efficiency and customer experience across multiple support channels. The work included benchmarking service standards, redesigning support flows, and defining differentiated service levels across customer segments. Impact: identified opportunities to reduce support friction and improve customer satisfaction across millions of annual customer interactions.

items.title: Marketplace Expansion & Commercial Strategy
items.description: Industry: Travel & Mobility Platforms. Supported strategic initiatives to expand marketplace offerings and strengthen commercial performance across new product lines. The work focused on identifying growth opportunities, aligning product and commercial teams, and prioritizing initiatives that increased marketplace value for customers and partners. Impact: contributed to marketplace expansion initiatives and improved revenue contribution from new verticals.

items.title: Premium Market Positioning & Buyer Strategy
items.description: Industry: International Trade & Food Supply Chains. Advised export organizations and producer groups on how to move beyond commodity positioning in European markets. The work focused on defining differentiation strategies, understanding premium buyer expectations, and developing clearer value propositions for sustainability-focused markets. Impact: strengthened positioning with European buyers and improved competitiveness in premium market segments.

consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.headline: I take on a small number of consulting engagements where I believe I can add genuine value — typically involving strategy, operations, growth, and market positioning, or a cominbation of these.
paragraphs: I’m most helpful when the work requires clear thinking, strong synthesis, and practical recommendations that can actually be executed.
I’m not looking for volume work or generic support projects. I prefer focused engagements where thoughtful outside perspective can materially improve the outcome.
consulting.bestFit: Best fit: founders, operators, and organizations facing meaningful strategic questions.
